_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant's father/mother must be a registered sanitation worker in the state of Chhattisgarh.
1. Benefits will be provided only up to two children. 
1. Scholarship recipients must study for at least one year and cannot stop studying. If they do, they must return the scholarship.
1. Students cannot receive benefits from two government scholarship schemes simultaneously.
